name: PoleLine
shortDescription: Draw your racing line. Chase your own best across 25 fictional circuits.
subtitle: Draw the lap. Find your flow.
description:
A great lap begins with a line.

Choose your tyres, draw a racing line with your finger, then watch your toy racer bring it to life. A smoother corner can be quicker than a shorter route. Find the balance, improve your sectors and chase your personal best ghost.

A WORLD OF YOUR OWN
Explore 25 original fictional circuits, from forgiving Pocket Park to the long curves of Aurora Bay. Pick one of six fictional racing teams and earn bronze, silver and gold medals.

YOUR LINE MAKES THE DIFFERENCE
Tyre temperature, grip, braking, battery use and corner shape all affect your lap. Read the result, try another approach and find the next fraction of a second.

MADE FOR OFFLINE PLAY
All circuits and gameplay are included with your paid download. Play offline from your first launch. No account, ads, in-app purchases, analytics or internet connection required. Your records and ghosts stay on your device.

Touch controls let you lift and continue, undo a stroke, zoom and pan. Pause a replay whenever you need to.

PoleLine is an original Toyboxes game from Randroid LLC.
releaseNotes: The first Toyboxes mobile release: 25 fictional circuits, touch-drawn racing lines, tyre strategy, local personal bests, ghost replays and fully offline single-player racing.
reviewNotes: No login or network connection is needed. Start with Pocket Park, choose tyres, draw from the chequered flag in the direction of the yellow arrows, then choose Race your line. Lift and continue from the purple tip. Pinch to zoom or use Zoom / tip. Finish lap opens results immediately. Records and ghosts are stored locally. This is a paid download without ads or in-app purchases.
